title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: After a bad call
hook: The umpire gets one wrong. Your players are watching you.
intro: The call goes against your team.
Players look to the dugout to see how you react.
statement: How you react to a bad call teaches more than any drill.
q1: Do you say nothing and move on —
q2: or acknowledge it and help kids let it go?
q3: What will your players do next time it happens?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But players move on faster
cta: Coaches — what do you do after a bad call?
ctaLines: Next play. Shrug and smile. Talk about it later.
Let it go or name it?
ctaPrompt: Share your dugout habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
The umpire gets one wrong. Your players are watching you.
The call goes against your team. Players look to the dugout to see how you react.
How you react to a bad call teaches more than any drill.
Move on quietly or name it and let it go. There is no perfect answer.
What do you do after a bad call? Share your habit in the comments.
